1.  2024 Tour de France - Wikipedia
    The 111th edition of the Tour de France started in Florence, Italy, and finished in Nice, France, without passing through Paris. Tadej Pogačar won his third title, while Mark Cavendish broke Eddy Merckx's record of stage wins.
